name: human-gangup-web
notes: Gang-up web baseline (docs/HUMAN-AI.md §9). Vanilla: every AI faction adds +1 to +2.25 hate a month toward the strongest human faction overall (JealousyAndDeescalation); toward the player only beyond a minimum ideological distance. The human-hate record sums every human-to-human hate change by cause per month. Analyse with tools/hate.py <run dir>. Info only until the personality web lands.
info: [(e['t'][:7], e['strongest']) for e in events('human-hate', f='ResistCouncil')][::3]
